> 译注：npm 软件包网页在本次检查中返回 HTTP 403；可通过 [npm 官方注册表](https://registry.npmjs.org/skills)查看包信息。 # skills 开放智能体技能生态的命令行工具。 智能体技能是可复用的说明，指导编码智能体完成代码审查、使用库等任务。可在 [skills.sh](https://skills.sh) 发现技能。 支持 **OpenCode**、**Claude Code**、**Codex**、**Cursor** 和[另外 75 种智能体](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/agents.md).

## 安装技能 需要 Node.js 22.20 或更高版本。在项目目录运行： ```bash npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills ``` 选择要安装的技能和目标编码智能体。技能默认安装到当前项目；添加 `-g` 可使其跨项目可用。 ```bash # Choose one skill and agent npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill web-design-guidelines -a claude-code # Browse available skills npx skills find ``` 有关来源格式、私有仓库和全部选项，请参阅[安装参考](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/commands.md#skills-add)。 ## 其他命令 | 命令 | 说明 | | --------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | | `npx skills find [query]` | 搜索技能 | | `npx skills list` | 列出已安装技能 | | `npx skills use @` | 无需安装即可使用一个技能 | | `npx skills check` | 检查可用更新 | | `npx skills update [skills...]` | 更新已安装技能 | | `npx skills remove [skills...]` | 移除已安装技能 | | `npx skills init [name]` | 创建技能模板 | 请阅读 [CLI 参考](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/commands.md)，或运行 `npx skills --help` 查看示例和选项。实验性命令列于[下方](#实验性功能). ## 无需安装即可使用技能 为技能生成提示词，或使用该技能启动受支持的编码智能体： ```bash npx skills use vercel-labs/agent-skills@web-design-guidelines --agent claude-code ``` 省略 `--agent` 可改为打印提示词。请参阅 [`skills use`](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/commands.md#skills-use). ## 实验性功能
以 experimental_ 开头的命令为预览功能，其名称、选项和行为可能在任何版本中更改或删除，恕不另行通知。 | 命令 | 说明 | | --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | | `npx skills experimental_sync` | 将 npm 依赖附带的技能同步到项目 | | `npx skills experimental_install` | 恢复 `skills-lock.json` 中记录的项目技能 | 一些 npm 包在代码之外还为智能体提供说明。同步会将它们链接到项目，使其随依赖更新，并安装 `package.json` 中声明的技能包： ```bash npm install -D skills agent-browser npx skills experimental_sync -y ``` 选项、`skills` 字段和背后的 [RFC](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/issues/2323)，请参阅[实验命令参考](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/commands.md#experimental-commands)。
## 支持的智能体 CLI 会检测已安装的智能体，并让你选择技能的安装位置。请参阅[所有支持的智能体、安装路径和兼容性](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/agents.md). ## 创建技能 ```bash npx skills init my-skill ``` 编辑生成的 `SKILL.md`，写入给智能体的说明。有关格式与发现规则，请参阅[创建与分享技能](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/creating-skills.md)。 ## 文档 - [CLI 参考](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/commands.md): 安装、命令示例和实验性功能 - [支持的智能体](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/agents.md): 智能体名称、技能目录和兼容性 - [创建技能](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/creating-skills.md): frontmatter、仓库结构和插件 - [故障排除与配置](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/troubleshooting.md): 常见问题、环境变量和遥测 ## 遥测 CLI 会收集匿名使用数据。设置 `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1` 或 `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` 可禁用遥测与安全审计请求。 请参阅[收集的内容](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/troubleshooting.md#telemetry). ## 相关链接 - [技能目录](https://skills.sh) - [Agent Skills 规范](https://agentskills.io) - [Vercel Agent Skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills) ## 许可证 本项目采用 [MIT 许可证](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/LICENSE).
en:
# skills The CLI for the open agent skills ecosystem. Agent skills are reusable instructions that teach coding agents how to perform tasks, from reviewing code to working with a library. Discover skills at [skills.sh](https://skills.sh). Supports **OpenCode**, **Claude Code**, **Codex**, **Cursor**, and [75 more](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/agents.md).

## Install a Skill Requires Node.js 22.20 or later. Run this from your project: ```bash npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills ``` Choose the skills and coding agents to install to. Skills are installed to the current project by default; add `-g` to make them available across projects. ```bash # Choose one skill and agent npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill web-design-guidelines -a claude-code # Browse available skills npx skills find ``` See the [installation reference](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/commands.md#skills-add) for source formats, private repositories, and all options. ## Other Commands | Command | Description | | --------------------------------- | -------------------------------- | | `npx skills find [query]` | Search for skills | | `npx skills list` | List installed skills | | `npx skills use @` | Use one skill without installing | | `npx skills check` | Check for available updates | | `npx skills update [skills...]` | Update installed skills | | `npx skills remove [skills...]` | Remove installed skills | | `npx skills init [name]` | Create a skill template | Read the [CLI reference](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/commands.md) or run `npx skills --help` for examples and options. Experimental commands are listed [below](#experimental-features). ## Use a Skill Without Installing Generate a prompt for a skill, or launch a supported coding agent with it: ```bash npx skills use vercel-labs/agent-skills@web-design-guidelines --agent claude-code ``` Omit `--agent` to print the prompt instead. See [`skills use`](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/commands.md#skills-use). ## Experimental Features
Commands prefixed with experimental_ are previews. Their names, options, and behavior may change or be removed in any release without notice. | Command | Description | | --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | | `npx skills experimental_sync` | Sync skills shipped by npm dependencies into your project | | `npx skills experimental_install` | Restore project skills recorded in `skills-lock.json` | Some npm packages bundle instructions for your agent alongside their code. Sync links them into your project so they update with the dependency, and also installs skill packs declared in `package.json`: ```bash npm install -D skills agent-browser npx skills experimental_sync -y ``` See the [experimental commands reference](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/commands.md#experimental-commands) for options, the `skills` field, and the [RFC](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/issues/2323) behind it.
## Supported Agents The CLI detects installed agents and lets you choose where skills are installed. See [all supported agents, installation paths, and compatibility](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/agents.md). ## Creating Skills ```bash npx skills init my-skill ``` Edit the generated `SKILL.md` with instructions for your agent. See [creating and sharing skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/creating-skills.md) for the format and discovery rules. ## Documentation - [CLI reference](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/commands.md): installation, command examples, and experimental features - [Supported agents](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/agents.md): agent names, skill directories, and compatibility - [Creating skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/creating-skills.md): frontmatter, repository layouts, and plugins - [Troubleshooting and configuration](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/troubleshooting.md): common problems, environment variables, and telemetry ## Telemetry The CLI collects anonymous usage data. Set `DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1` or `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` to disable telemetry and security-audit requests. See [what is collected](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/docs/troubleshooting.md#telemetry). ## Related Links - [Skills Directory](https://skills.sh) - [Agent Skills Specification](https://agentskills.io) - [Vercel Agent Skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-skills) ## License This project is licensed under the [MIT License](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills/blob/7a5e920bead4b1039a6d6df5d7e1163b7b09423a/LICENSE).
